MASS ASSOCIATION CAPUCHIN FATHERS 225 JEROME STREET BrROOKLYN, N.Y. September 11th 1945
Miss Doris Panyard 1705 Peck St. Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard.
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor Rec'd and noted yesterday. I am glad to know thing are smoothing along favor- ably. Hope Grace keep up courage and shake off the enemy of soul and body - Worry.
Glad to hear my namesake is already able to display his ener- gies, even if as yet only on all fours. Thanks be to God for all His blessings.
I hope the Kuhns meet no serious difficulty in finding a suitable location.
Tell Mother not to be anxious or too disapointed about our proposed visit. Only three years more and we'll have another chapter and who knows what they'll do with adjusting of the, us.
Best way I find is simply to leave Every thing we have - and every thing we ourselves - in God's holy keeping. Many thanks for your prof- fered favor of copies of the "Rhyme Letter" I surely would appreciate a few dozen. I am sending a copy of another one of Fr. Ed's just for your- self. Possibly you made it yourself. At all events, I hope you'll like
Hoping this finds you all well and improving - Fred too praying sometimes for me I beg to remain
Sincerely Yours in Christ. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. P.S. I've mailed the plaques, etc to the parties in Ann Arbor, Lansing and Muskegon. Praise The Lord!
